instruction: Can you set a "wheel" transition for the fourth page of my presentation?

command: import pyautogui; import time;  time.sleep(4); pyautogui.doubleClick(x={SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, y={SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);pyautogui.mouseDown(); pyautogui.mouseUp(); time.sleep(0.5);
import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(4.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a 'wheel' transition to slide 4 (0-indexed: 3). The evaluator uses the existing check_transition function which parses the PPTX XML to verify the transition element is present in the slide XML. The presentation has 24 slides total, so slide indices 0-4 are all valid. No custom functions needed as check_transition already exists in slides.py.
metadata.verification: Verified by examining the check_transition function in slides.py:838-873. The function parses ppt/slides/slide{slide_idx+1}.xml and searches for <p:transition><p:wheel> element. For slide_idx=3, it will check ppt/slides/slide4.xml for the wheel transition. The presentation has 24 slides confirmed by python-pptx examination.
